_comment: Baselines for structural_scan.py, measured from YOUR target writer.
The values here are the placeholder defaults and describe no real person.
Replace every one of them. See README, 'Calibrate it to your own writer'.
Measure one register at a time. A writer's cold-email numbers and their
published-content numbers are different, and averaging them produces a
profile that matches neither. Keep one file per register:
corpus_words is the size of the corpus the three raw counts are per, so
the scanner can rate-normalize a document of any length against it.
Unknown keys are ignored with a warning.
label: example: unnamed writer, marketing-content register, N words
